jobs.description:
As a Material Handler (Woodwork), you are responsible for ensuring that materials and internal orders are processed safely, accurately, and on time. You work according to clear procedures and play an important role in supporting the daily logistics process within the production environment.

Your responsibilities include:

- Transporting materials between cleanrooms and production departments.
- Packing and unpacking products for storage and transport.
- Moving internal orders using an EPT (Electric Pallet Truck) and a stacker.
- Performing quality checks on incoming and outgoing materials.
- Identifying and reporting logistical bottlenecks.
- Registering internal orders correctly in the logistics system.
- Keeping the warehouse and workplace clean, safe, and organized.

You will work full-time in a 2-shift schedule:

- Morning shift: 06:00 – 15:00
- Evening shift: 15:00 – 00:00

You will receive an 18% shift allowance for working in the 2-shift schedule. English is the primary language used on the work floor.

- Experience in logistics or warehouse work
- Good command of the English language
- Ability to work independently and within a team
- EPT certificate or willingness to obtain one through us after at least 1 year of experience
- Willingness to work in a 2-shift schedule
- Living in the Eindhoven, Helmond, Veldhoven, Veghel, or Valkenswaard region is a plus
